description_for_human: Track hedge fund 13F holdings from SEC EDGAR. See what 82 institutional investors own, what they are buying and selling, and how ownership of any stock has changed over 8 quarters.
description_for_model: Provides hedge fund 13F holdings data sourced from SEC EDGAR filings. Use this to answer questions about: which funds own a specific stock, what a specific manager is buying or selling, top stocks held by hedge funds, consensus buys and sells, portfolio overlap between funds, and filing dates. All data is quarterly with up to 8 quarters of history. Options (PUT/CALL) are excluded from calculations. Values are in USD thousands unless value_multiplier applies.

funds_list.description: Master list of all 82 tracked funds with id, name, CIK, and value_multiplier. Fetch this first to get fund IDs needed for other endpoints.

fund_holdings.description: All holdings for a specific fund across up to 8 quarters. Replace {fund_id} with the id field from funds.json. Example: https://13fai.com/data/berkshire.json
fund_holdings.format: JSON object with quarters keyed by YYYYQn label

stock_index.description: All stocks with per-fund ownership data, fund totals, and each fund's latest quarter. Use to find which funds own a given ticker, calculate portfolio weights, and identify current vs stale holders.
stock_index.format: JSON object with stocks, fund_totals, and fund_latest_q keys

ticker_mapping.description: Maps CUSIP identifiers to ticker symbols. Use to resolve CUSIPs from holdings data to recognizable tickers.

prices.description: Last known price and 52-week high/low per ticker. Check the updated field for data freshness.

consensus_activity.description: Most widely bought and sold stocks this quarter across all tracked funds.

static_stock_pages.description: Static ownership page for each of the top 200 stocks by aggregate hedge fund value. Example: https://13fai.com/stocks/AAPL-hedge-fund-ownership.html

static_manager_pages.description: Static bio page per manager with biography, investment philosophy, notable trades, and live top holdings. Example: https://13fai.com/warren-buffett-portfolio.html

data_notes.update_frequency: Quarterly. RSS monitor checks daily and fetches new filings within 24 hours of SEC submission.
data_notes.options_handling: PUT and CALL positions are included in raw holdings data but excluded from portfolio weight, share count, and period-over-period calculations. Filter by putcall === '' for equity-only analysis.
data_notes.value_units: All value fields in per-fund JSONs are USD thousands as filed. Multiply by value_multiplier from funds.json to get correct USD thousands. Funds with value_multiplier 1000: ako, aquamarine, baupost, duquesne, olstein, triple_frond.
data_notes.reported_price: Price at last filing is value * value_multiplier * 1000 / shares — an implied average as of quarter end, not an actual trade price.
data_notes.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.
